title: reduce GPU memory: activation checkpointing, scratch buffers, arena tuning
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: reduce peak GPU memory and workspace requirements for large-context serving workloads without regressing throughput. This PR applies three coordinated changes: 1) enable optional per-layer activation checkpointing for transformer blocks with a low-overhead recompute path; 2) convert large per-request scratch allocations into a pooled arena allocator with per-stream sub-allocators and size buckets; 3) tighten default scratch buffer sizing heuristics and kernel workspace hints so that kernels request smaller temporary workspaces where possible. The change is guarded behind runtime feature flags and config knobs so customers can opt-in gradual rollouts. Summary of changes: - activation checkpointing: adds checkpointing pass that records minimal forward state and recomputes intermediate activations on backward/kv-cache recompute paths; integrated with KV cache lookups to avoid duplicated buffers. - scratch arena: replaces ad-hoc cudaMalloc/cudaFree for ephemeral kernel temporaries with a lock-free arena per GPU stream; added bucketized free-lists and eviction thresholds to bound peak arena memory. - tuning heuristics: updated kernel workspace hint table (arch/seq_len -> workspace multiplier) and introduced a max_workspace_cap config to prevent pathological workspace growth. Compatibility: defaults are conservative (disabled for legacy 16-bit kernels) and we disable checkpointing for models that previously used custom opworkflows. Benchmarks: measured on a 16GB A100 node with 8k context on GPT-style model (1.3B) - peak GPU memory reduced by ~18% (from 10.9GB -> 8.95GB) when checkpointing + arena enabled; scratch/workspace utilization reduced ~22% on average across mixed batch sizes; end-to-end latency median increase +1.8% and p95 +3.4% under continuous-batching workload when checkpointing recompute is enabled. When running with arena + heuristic tuning only (no checkpointing), peak memory reduced ~11% with no measurable latency regression. Testing: unit tests for arena allocator and deterministic replay path for checkpointing; integration perf runs on perf-canary; stress test with continuous batching harness for 72 hours. Rollout plan: feature flags enabled in canary pool for 48h, then staged rollout to low-memory customers and Dedicated pools; telemetry dashboards added to observe arena growth and recompute stalls. See related tasks ENG-4123 and ENG-4180.

review_comments: Ethan Li (2026-02-19): Nice overall. A few nits: prefer explicit alignment guarantees in arena_alloc() and add a stress test for inter-stream contention.
Priya Nair (2026-02-20): Can we make checkpointing opt-in per-model? Concerned about regressions for low-latency customers. Please add telemetry counters for recompute time and recompute memory.
Carlos Vega (2026-02-21): Kernel workspace hint table looks OK, but we should add a fallback path to max_workspace_cap early in the kernel launch path to avoid OOMs if hinting is wrong.
Perf bot (2026-02-22): Perf canary shows ~1.8% median latency increase with checkpointing; acceptable for low-memory targets.
author_responses: Maya Thompson (2026-02-20): Addressed alignment and added unit test for inter-stream contention. See arena_allocator.cpp changes.

Maya Thompson (2026-02-21): Checkpointing is opt-in per-deployment via runtime flag and per-model via model_config.checkpointing.enabled; added telemetry counters (recompute_time_ms, recompute_memory_bytes).
Maya Thompson (2026-02-22): Added early clamp to max_workspace_cap in kernel launch path; updated docs with recommended caps per GPU family.
release_notes: - Reduced peak GPU memory for medium/large context workloads via activation checkpointing and arena-based scratch allocation; - Introduced arena allocator to reduce ephemeral cudaMalloc/free churn and bound scratch growth; - Added kernel workspace hints and max_workspace_cap to prevent pathological workspace allocation; - Feature flags for staged rollout; telemetry for recompute and arena growth added.
